summary_en: Declaration of the Sacred Congregation of Rites fixing the 1969 calendar for places where the solemnities of the Epiphany, the Ascension and Corpus Christi are no longer of precept and have been transferred to Sunday: Epiphany on Sunday 5 January (Holy Name of Jesus moved to Monday 6 January), Ascension on Sunday 18 May (Vigil on Saturday 17 May; the weekday of 14 May with commemoration of St Boniface, St John Baptist de la Salle on 15 May, St Ubald on 16 May) and Corpus Christi on Sunday 8 June (St Boniface on 5 June, St Norbert on 6 June, Saturday of Our Lady on 7 June), with the Scripture readings of the Office reassigned accordingly. No protocol number is printed. Marked for review because the declaration binds only where the transfer indult is in force, so the reviewer should confirm the general_calendar classification.
excerpt: haec Sacra Congregatio Rituum declarat, in locis ubi supradicta festa iam non sunt de praecepto, adveniente anno 1969 servandum esse Calendarium quod sequitur: Die 5 ianuarii, Dominica: IN EPIPHANIA DOMINI, I cl. Die 6 ianuarii, feria II: SS. Nominis Iesu, II cl. [...] Die 18 maii, Dominica: IN ASCENSIONE DOMINI, I cl. [...] Die 8 iunii, Dominica: SS.MI CORPORIS CHRISTI, I cl.
